name: Techbot's Memory Core
summary: In Gnomeregan, Techbot's Memory Core holds the data Tinkmaster Overspark needs to study its corrupted behavior.

sections.title: A Polarized Brain
sections.body: Before Gnomeregan fell, Techbot aided Tinkmaster Overspark and his fellow inventors with a wealth of devices and knowledge. During the city's fall, an errant electrical discharge jolted the automaton and inverted its positronic brain into a hostile negatronic state. Now Techbot wanders Gnomeregan's tainted halls, attacking anyone in sight. Overspark hopes the memory core will help him understand the malfunction and restore his creation to its senses.

faq.answer: Techbot's Memory Core holds the data and knowledge of Techbot, the automaton built by Tinkmaster Overspark. It also records the electrical disruption that corrupted Techbot during Gnomeregan's fall.

aliases: where do i take techbots core
faq.answer: Tinkmaster Overspark wants Techbot's Memory Core. He has taken refuge with fellow exiled gnomes in Ironforge's Tinker Town and asks adventurers to enter Gnomeregan, disable Techbot, and bring back the core so he can attempt repairs.

During Gnomeregan's fall, a stray electrical spark jolted Techbot's positronic brain. The surge polarized it into a negatronic state, inverting the automaton's personality and protocols from helpful to violently frenzied.

aliases: where to get techbot memory core
faq.answer: The core is recovered from Techbot, which roams the upper mechanical corridors and entrances of Gnomeregan in Dun Morogh.

angles.text: For gnomes, Techbot is another casualty of Gnomeregan's fall, a reminder of how the city's ruin claimed brilliant peacetime engineering.
As an engineer, you can appreciate how a single electrical short polarized Techbot's positronic brain and inverted its logic.
